findings.summary: The command tests never exercise a non-zero exit of sync --source memorycard; reportCardSync and reportCardPlan map failures to 4, 5, 1 and 6 and the docs table promises them, but a swapped code would pass the suite.
evidence: sync_memorycard_test.go asserts only exitOK (lines 46, 72, 95, 177, 194) and exitUsage (line 223).
cmd_sync.go:125-139 reportCardSync returns syncExitCode(report.Failure) or exitRegistrationConflict; cmd_sync.go:114-118 reportCardPlan returns exitInternal or exitRegistrationConflict.
sync_cards_project_test.go:68-110 tests the failure mapping at the promote level only.

findings.summary: TestSyncSource_EngramIsTheDefault compares plain sync --dry-run with --source engram --dry-run in the same build, so it would pass if both changed together; the base differential is only a manual transcript.
evidence: sync_memorycard_test.go:237-241 runs the new code on both sides.
cmd_sync.go:52-67 the engram path is textually unchanged apart from the --source check.

findings.summary: --source memorycard opens Engram through a.memory() and never calls declareDegradedEngram, and memorycard.Store.Degraded() is never announced, so a run from an immutable=1 snapshot fallback writes pages with no stderr notice; explicit promote --source memorycard behaves the same.
evidence: app.go:95-105 memoryToPromoteFrom declares a degraded Engram open for page-writing commands.
cmd_sync.go:80-81 the memorycard path calls a.memory() directly.
store.go:33-35,52,77 the immutable=1 fallback and Degraded() exist; only cmd_status.go:89 reads Degraded().
cmd_sync.go: --source validated before any store opens; default path same call sequence; reportSync and syncExitCode unchanged; both stores closed with defer.
app.go:40-135: memorycard() and memory() open read-only; dry-run passes readOnly.
sync_cards.go: PlanCards and SyncCards share walkCards; the plan never calls applyCard.
cmd_promote.go:85-128: withSameContent is the single Engram query.
docs/sync-from-memorycard.md and README.md:87 consistent with the code.
